hideTooMuchData.message: To protect browser performance output records limit was imposed on the widget. Please apply filters or narrow down analysed time frame to display the results.

queries.nql: ixTcpAppResponseTime > 0 | aggr ixAvgTcpAppResponseTimeRaw=avg(ixTcpAppResponseTime) by ixApplication as ixApplication unwind=true | set ixAvgTcpAppResponseTime=div(ixAvgTcpAppResponseTimeRaw,1000) | sort ixAvgTcpAppResponseTime desc | limit 10
